title: Phone Book
description:
Process commands, one per line, until `quit`:

- `add <name> <number>`: store the contact (no output)
- `find <name>`: print the number, or `<name> not found`
- `delete <name>`: remove the contact (no output)

Use a dictionary.

visible_tests.stdin:
add Asha 111
find Asha
find Zoya
quit

hidden_tests.stdin:
add A 1
add A 2
find A
quit

add B 5
delete B
find B
quit
